Geary Boulevard.fact: There have been feasibility studies by Muni that have investigated the possibility of creating a light rail or subway line on Geary, but no plans have been adopted.

Geary Boulevard.subject: Important Days
Geary Boulevard.question: There is a pedestrian overpass in the Japantown neighborhood at _____; an additional overpass at Steiner Street was demolished in 2020
Geary Boulevard.fact: There is a pedestrian overpass in the Japantown neighborhood at Webster Street; an additional overpass at Steiner Street was demolished in 2020.

Geary Boulevard.subject: Important Days
Geary Boulevard.question: Cable cars were operated on the street from 1880 to 1912 by the _____, Park and Ocean Railway
Geary Boulevard.fact: Cable cars were operated on the street from 1880 to 1912 by the Geary Street, Park and Ocean Railway. Despite its name, the Geary Street Park & Ocean Railway never actually reached the ocean.

Geary Boulevard.subject: Important Days
Geary Boulevard.question: In 1892, the cable car line was extended to 5th Avenue, where it turned south to reach _____ directly
Geary Boulevard.fact: They initially ran from Market Street to Central (now Presidio), connecting to an extension running steam-powered cars along Geary to 1st Avenue (now Arguello), whereupon they turned south to approach Golden Gate Park. In 1892, the cable car line was extended to 5th Avenue, where it turned south to reach Golden Gate Park directly.
